verdict.line: You lose if you trade inside his E (Apprehend) range and eat a hooked all-in before level 6; you win if you force him to commit E on minions or whiff it, then grind him down with W walls and E (Mourning Mist) poke.

brief.thesis: This is a 52.2% win rate over 1172 games because neither side has a clean mechanical answer to the other — Darius wins by landing Apprehend and stacking Hemorrhage to 5 for the enrage, you win by denying that hook with Dark Procession and out-sustaining him with Last Rites. The matchup is decided by whether you respect his E cooldown or walk into it.

theirWindow.when: His E is up and you're near minions
theirWindow.what: Darius can sweep you with Apprehend (range 535, cooldown 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s) and pull you into melee range, then chain Q (Decimate) and W (Crippling Strike) to stack Hemorrhage fast. Hold position outside 535 range or stand behind a minion he'd rather not hook.

yourWindow.when: He's thrown E on a minion or it's down
yourWindow.what: Trade freely — land E (Mourning Mist) for the armor shred, slow and mark, then use Q (Last Rites) on your next auto for the bonus damage and heal. He has no way back into range for several seconds.

powerCurve.note: Q heal and early Hemorrhage stacking win short trades
W wall starts blocking his E engage
E slow/shred plus Q sustain outlasts his damage
His true-damage R punishes any overextension
Maiden (R) and item power swing extended fights

start.why: Run 53.3% over 732 games — the regen and poke-block absorb his early auto trades and Decimate pokes while you wait for W.

boots.why: 72.3% pick rate and 52.7% win rate — the flat auto-attack reduction directly undercuts Hemorrhage stacking and his enrage window.

core.why: First item on the strongest listed path (59.1% win over 44 games) — gives you the stats to trade evenly before his items come online.
Armor shred stacks with your E's own armor reduction, so your extended trades and skirmishes hit harder than his.
Cooldown refund on E (Mourning Mist) and Q (Last Rites) lets you reapply the slow/mark and heal far more often in prolonged fights.

situational.when: he is snowballing and his R (Noxian Guillotine) threatens to burst you in one hit
he or his team is stacking armor to blunt your physical damage
lane is won and you want to split push and pressure towers instead of grouping

runes.keystoneWhy: Run on 22.8% of games at 52.4% win — the stacking adaptive force rewards exactly the prolonged auto-trading this matchup becomes once W blocks his engage. High-elo players instead favor Grasp of the Undying (51.7% win, 5,865 games at master+) for a tankier lane-sustain approach if you'd rather out-heal his poke than out-damage it.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the top pick at 46.7% with a 50.4% win rate, letting you dodge his E engage with Flash and still return to lane or reset waves after trading. Flash+Ignite (55.8% win, 38.5% pick) is the stronger option if you're confident you out-trade him and want to close out early kills.

playing.title: Never stand inside 535 range idle
playing.detail: Darius' E (Apprehend) hooks anything in that range on a 26-16s cooldown. Last-hit from max auto range and only step in to trade when you've confirmed it's down.

playing.title: Wall him off with W
playing.detail: Dark Procession (cooldown 20/18/16/14/12s) blocks movement through it — drop it behind you when he commits E, or between you and him pre-emptively to deny the engage entirely.

playing.title: Track his Hemorrhage stacks
playing.detail: At 5 stacks Darius enrages for massive bonus AD. Disengage before he caps stacks rather than trading through the enrage window.

playing.title: Poke with E before committing Q
playing.detail: Mourning Mist's armor shred and slow set up your Last Rites auto for bonus damage and sustain — throw E first so the follow-up auto does more and you heal more.

playing.title: Don't fight below 50% without W up
playing.detail: His R (Noxian Guillotine) is true damage and scales with your Hemorrhage stacks — at 6s cooldown late it can chain twice if he gets a reset, so bank W as an escape, not just an engage tool.

playing.title: Use Maiden to reset ghoul pressure
playing.detail: R (Eulogy of the Isles) raises Walkers from anything it kills — use it in skirmishes near his jungle or dead minions to snowball side-lane pressure after level 6.

playing.title: Play the trade, not the all-in
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read holds: keep distance, use W and E to poke, and only trap him in W to finish with Q and E once he's already low — don't initiate full commits.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured OP.GG data from games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis, not sourced numbers.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being pulled by his (E) by keeping your distance while using [W] and [E] to contest lane. If he is running low on health, trap him inside [W] and use [Q] and [E] to finish him off.
